objective: One hand passes over the head to the opposite side, with coordinated torso support and rod clearance
required_before_motion: Identify and read the actual PS debug serial port
Verify the ten-channel PWM image after reboot; turn servo power off before any image change
Restore and inspect advancing front and top camera frames
Establish a fresh held-to-OFF reference for the current boot; old command registers alone are insufficient
Keep the incident locks and stop configuration; do not replay the incident trajectories

stages.intent: Establish body support and place the other hand below the crossing corridor
checks: No arm is carrying the entire body
Shoulder and waist are not being pulled sideways

stages.intent: Raise the active hand outside the head silhouette before any crossing
checks: Check wrist, forearm and weapon together
Active arm clears the head and headdress
Rod clears the frame and neighboring rods

stages.intent: Probe active-hand lateral direction with head support held, then cross above the head
checks: Determine lateral response from fresh observations, not shared whole-body yaw
Do not infer 3D clearance from front-view silhouette overlap alone

stages.intent: Lower the hand on the opposite side while the other hand and body support follow as needed
checks: No rod winding or crossed-rod contact
Passive elbow and shoulder follow without torso distortion

stages.intent: Return over the same reviewed elevated corridor to the established reference
checks: Do not take a straight diagonal shortcut through the head
Stop without automatic return if abnormal contact, video loss or state mismatch occurs

validation_order: Repeat the same reviewed closed route
Opposite hand as a separate route
Only then combine into double-hand crossing
